Sub: Audio recording of Earnings Conference Call for Financial Performance for the 2nd Quarter 
ended 30 September 2026 held on Thursday, 22 October 2026 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Further to our letter dated 16 October 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) read with 
Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations and other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing 
Regulations, we would like to inform you that the audio recording of earnings conference call for 
Financial Performance for the 2nd Quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 held on Thursday, 
22 October 2026 at 04:00 p.m. (IST), has been uploaded on the website of the Company, which can be 
accessed at the following link: 
https://himadri.com/pdf/Himadri_Q2_FY27_Concall.mp3 
 
The above information will be made available on the Company’s website at www.himadri.com 
You are requested to take the same on record. 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd  
 
 
 
Monika Saraswat 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
